heading: Umbraco & .NET developer in Kathmandu
biography: I'm Saroj Shrestha. I build websites with Umbraco and .NET — mostly from Kathmandu, and since 2023 with ZAAKS!

I care about the backoffice feeling obvious for editors: clear document types, sensible Block Lists, and Razor that doesn't fight you every time content changes. When something repeats in the wild, I turn it into a package on GitHub — like Block Field Visibility for Block List fields.
Reach out on the contact page if you want to connect — GitHub or LinkedIn is fine.

workSection.heading: Umbraco & .NET at ZAAKS!
workSection.intro: Since 2023 I build Umbraco sites and backoffices in Kathmandu — document types, Block Lists, Razor, and .NET integrations. I also maintain open-source packages on GitHub when they solve a real editor or dev problem.

lifeSection.heading: Movies, gym, riding & hiking
lifeSection.intro: I like a clear split between work and everything else. Evenings for films, steady gym time in Kathmandu, rides when the road calls, and hikes in the hills when I can get away for a day.
